facts.text: Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight with a great sword, was left incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound and may recover and attack anyone who goes back down to him.

The Free Goblin Society goblins are staying in the Barrow Mound's church, antechamber and statue room and agreed to wall off the stairs down to the incapacitated Sir Alfred. If he recovers and gets past the wall, he may kill more of them.
Brother Dirk regards Sir Alfred as holy and did not want him destroyed. Why does Sir Alfred, a huge undead knight with a greatsword, roam the Barrow Mound?
